settings.title: Port control
settings.description:
Selected ports are opened when the device has been away for the given delay and closed as soon as it is back. ★ = device with a DHCP reservation.

{test_result}

data_description.active_from: Outside active hours the ports are always closed. Same time in both fields = always active.
data_description.notify_services: Where to send notifications. Phones/laptops with the Home Assistant Companion app appear as notify.mobile_app_*.
data_description.send_test: Tick and press Submit to send a test to the selected channels — the form stays open. Untick to save.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the router is checked. Presence is detected with up to this delay.
